requirements.text: Before implementation record start revision and pre-existing uncommitted changes; read /.agents/notes/index.md if present; do not include unrelated work.
Step 0 verifies every repository/environment grounding row, reporting expected versus actual; stop on contradictions changing design, outcomes, scope or verification, otherwise record and continue.
Before edits record failing-test identities for tests/*.test.ts and every docs/specs/*.tests/ (including Python); distinguish pre-existing failures from new SPEC-0019 contract failures.

Keep production changes within §5; never edit, skip or weaken any protected spec .tests/ or tests/*.test.ts. Do not change scripts/run-plan.mjs, planner prompt, gate checks, models/thinking, quota semantics, integration-report content or run-record format (except the allowed deleted review-branch reference).

Invariant: only landReviewBranch's post-passing-grade fast-forward may move the target's checked-out branch; failures never move target branches. Installer's explicitly required path-scoped add-spec commit is the pre-run O6 exception, not a landing. Never reset branches, force branch movement, rebase or create a merge commit. Existing forced worktree removal is not branch movement. Commit locally on the starting branch; never push, alter remotes or remote branches, tags, PRs or releases, or rewrite others' commits.
Defer the full model-driven external run and SPEC-0018 absent-.agent/missing-index handoff exercise. Full real landing is Lucas's next pipeline run, not a passing test claimed here.

uncommittedSpecPaths(dirty: string[], paths: { spec: string; tests: string }): string[] returns matching paths in input order: exact spec, tests directory/descendants, or an untracked trailing-slash ancestor of either. Parse XY porcelain and rename destinations; avoid prefix sibling false positives.

PreflightInput gains optional specPaths; matching uncommitted paths add one blocker naming the spec, HEAD and all matching paths. Existing dirty warning remains. Without specPaths preflight is exactly unchanged.
gateRepairable(errors: string[]): boolean is false iff any error equals exactly verification count changed; other errors and empty lists remain repairable.
landReviewBranch({ target, branch, base, baseBranch, enabled }) first refuses disabled landing with a reason containing disabled.
Next refuse null baseBranch with detached in reason, then a different currently checked-out branch (symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD) with current branch identified; no branch mutations.
Next compare rev-parse baseBranch with recorded base; on mismatch return not landed with moved in reason.
Then git merge --ff-only review branch; failure returns not landed with fast-forward and git's first error line, never discarding conflicting local edits.

After successful fast-forward, delete review branch via branch -d, ignoring deletion failure, and return { landed: true, onto: baseBranch, reason }; preserve unrelated local edits and avoid merge commits.
Landing result is { landed: boolean; onto?: string; reason: string }; each refusal leaves both branches as before; no merge commits, rebase, reset or force anywhere in landing.

New buildSummary({ runDir, outcome: { ok, stage, reason, next?, landed?, branch? } }): string produces deterministic markdown solely from runDir files, without a model call or writes; missing files are reported without throwing. Sections follow §6.3 order.
Summary starts with spec ID from pipeline.json, then Failed / Handed off / Landed on <branch>, stage and reason, kept review branch and optional next instruction.
Run section includes spec path, seven-character start commit, start branch, start time and run directory, reporting missing metadata.
Plan gate section lists each gate-N.log as Gate round N+1 with errors; gate.json pass yields Passed; neither source yields not reached.
Tasks section lists every results.jsonl row's id, acceptance, model, rounds and providerCost; absent results yields none recorded.
Final grade renders spec tests, plan tests and typecheck pass/fail/not run from grade.json codes; no grade yields Grade not reached.

Sessions table recursively includes every *telemetry.db under runDir except directories named branch or work, using read-only node:sqlite inference_calls queries; no model call or external run-directory read.
Each session row names the file without -telemetry.db, counts calls, sums prompt_tokens and completion_tokens and formats cost_usd as $0.00; include total row even with zero sessions.
Last summary section links the absolute report.md path only when present; integration evidence content remains untouched.
ProgressEvent done gains optional landed?: string and summaryPath?: string; stages must also accept install and land so runner stages reach UI.
parseProgressLine rejects present non-string landed or summaryPath, preserving all existing validation.
progressSummary and renderProgress display Landed on <landed> instead of Handed off, suppress Branch: if landed is set, and show Summary: <summaryPath> when present, including compact rendering.
Progress output without new fields is unchanged; preserve event reduction, costs, activity, roles and child-event/final-text behaviour.

Runner real preflight supplies specPaths using specRel/testRel; dirty spec/tests block with exit 2 before branch, worktree, run directory or model call. Dry run omits specPaths, warning via stderr and notice with all uncommittedSpecPaths. Other uncommitted work remains a warning.
At fresh run start record base=rev-parse HEAD and baseBranch=symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD or null in pipeline.json; create review branch from that exact base.
Runner tracks current stage and run directory as soon as it exists, including partial setup, failures, resumes and forwarded task/integration events.

Every finish/exit after the directory exists writes runDir/summary.md using buildSummary and includes absolute summaryPath in its single done event; cover terminal and JSON modes, success, plan-only, failures, exceptions, hold and interruption.
exit supplies next: for 75/130 name resumable implement_spec and terminal --resume routes; for other failures fix reason then start new run, naming retained worktree location.
Summary write failure prints stderr diagnostic without changing exit code or losing the original done outcome; no summary required before run directory creation.

After writing gate-N.log, a nonrepairable count mismatch exits 1 immediately with no repair pi call; explain run spec differs from preflight input, commit and start a new run. Other gate errors retain existing two-repair policy.
Both terminal and progress plan-only paths invoke finish(true, text, { branch }) so summary is written; retain review worktree for resume.
Only after passing final grade, handoff commit and both worktree removals emit land and call landReviewBranch with enabled=settings.pipeline?.land !== false. Never call on failures.
Landed finish includes landed and runRecord, not kept branch; refusal includes branch/runRecord and reason in summary. Terminal mode prints one outcome line either way; update runner header comment.
Legacy resumed runs without recorded base/baseBranch must not land or infer a new base; keep review branch and report missing metadata reason, preserving resume behaviour otherwise.
Tool handoff success requires not aborted, exit 0, done.ok, runRecord and either branch or landed; isError false with no stop sentence.

Tool plan-only success requires planOnly requested, exit 0, ok, branch and no runRecord; isError false with progress summary and exactly Plan gate passed on `<branch>`. To implement it, call implement_spec again with resume: true. No stop sentence.
All other tool outcomes retain SPEC-0018 diagnostics and isError true ending with STOP_AND_REPORT; summaryPath is exposed through progressSummary.
Tool spec parameter describes ID/slug/path or downloaded .md/.zip installed then run; pass caller string through unchanged, including ~/ paths.
Replace tool's never-writes-main sentence with passing-run fast-forward of unchanged starting branch, otherwise review branch. Retain Sol plans/Luna implements/Sol integrates and stop sentences.

Preserve factory/harness/target ownership, direct exposure, env cleanup, streaming, signal/abort behaviour, existing parameters and renderers; do not add an extension or move stop instructions into prompts.

New installSpec({ target: string, source: string, today: string, dryRun?: boolean }): InstallResult returns success { ok: true, id, slug, spec, tests, title, indexRow, committed, commit? } with repo-relative spec/tests and null absent tests, or refusal { ok: false, error }.
Accept only .zip or .md. Zip entries may be at root or docs/specs; source must have exactly one SPEC-<ID>-<slug>.md excluding run records; anything else/refused count returns error.
Install only selected spec and matching <stem>.tests directory; .md uses sibling tests; ignore other entries. Extract zip to scratch and always remove it on every path.
NNNN becomes one plus maximum all-digit existing spec-file and index-row ID, padded to four digits, 0001 when none. Explicit IDs retain spelling/value.
For placeholder installs replace every SPEC-NNNN in spec and test file contents with SPEC-<new ID> and rename installed spec/tests stem accordingly.
Refuse an ID already used by a different slug, without changing target files, index, staged work or HEAD.
Same ID/slug replaces spec and whole tests directory, including deleting stale tests or removing old directory when new source has none; do not duplicate existing index row.
Append index row only when ID absent, respecting existing header order: ID, H1 title, header Status or ready, today in column starting Date, em dash in other cells.
Create docs/specs if missing; missing index gets # Specifications and header | ID | Title | Status | Implemented by | Date first added | plus separator and row.
Stage/commit only installed spec, entire matching tests path including deletions, and index.md using path-scoped git commit -- <paths>; preserve unrelated staged and unstaged changes.
Commit message is Add SPEC-<id>: <title without SPEC prefix>. Return committed true and commit hash on changed install; identical install returns committed false without commit.
dryRun computes complete install result with committed false and writes nothing in target, including no new docs/specs/index, no index change or commit.
All installer refusals write nothing to target; validate source cardinality, ID conflicts and planned destinations before mutating target. Do not sweep unrelated work or source extras into commit.

Runner detects downloaded source before docs/specs existence check iff argument ends .md/.zip, resolves to existing file after leading ~/ expansion and lies outside target docs/specs; internal specs retain existing resolution behaviour.
Source runner emits install stage, invokes installSpec with target, expanded source, today's local date and dryRun; refusal exits 2 install failed: <error>; report success in notice and stderr.
Source --dry-run prints { install: result } and exits 0 without spec resolution, preflight, directory creation or model call.

Real source install continues resolving installed ID and preflights committed spec; run's recorded base is installer commit, including ~/Downloads inputs. Failed subsequent planning never moves that committed base.
Update only README pipeline-ending/usage lines to document download installs, default safe landing, pipeline.land false, review fallback, summary and plan-only resume, preserving unrelated docs.
Update agent/EXTENSIONS.md pipeline-tool description for installed downloads, safe landing, summary and plan-only success, preserving ownership/direct exposure/no-events and local failure reporting.

Run V1-V12 with protected SPEC-0019 test command and all Luna acceptance tests; review gate wiring that cannot be reached without planning. Record commands, results and repairs, never claim an unrun check passed.
V13 runs SPEC-0018, SPEC-0015 and tests/*.test.ts, comparing failing identities with step 0. All older spec-suite baselines remain known; do not repair unrelated pre-existing failures in this scope.
Apply §9: at most three repair rounds per failed check group; stop on design-changing contradiction, protected-test defect, scope growth, or repeated failure without a new testable diagnosis.

Report start revision, expected/actual grounding and baseline; every V-check command/output/status/repairs; O1-O6 evidence and §7 paths run; diff stat, empty protected diffs and complete changed functions/callers; deviations and unanticipated issues. Do not mark implemented during planning; final acceptance/status follows repository policy.

tasks.brief: Stage 0 evidence/constraints, one report file only. This is Sol's cross-file/environment audit, already performed by the planner before production edits; record rather than pretending this runs before Luna (run-plan executes Luna before integration). Start d78058484227a8f49c57a2b9242dc933b04706fe, git status --short empty, /.agents/notes/index.md absent. Expected/actual: preflight input fields and working-copy reads match; gate has three rounds and unconditional two repair opportunities, matches; exit calls finish(false,text) with one done, matches; metadata currently branch/spec/stamp/startedAt, matches; worktree removals then finish(true,{branch,runRecord}) matches JSON mode, terminal currently only console.log; done optional branch/runRecord/summary matches; tool requires branch+runRecord and treats plan-only as error, matches; description still never writes main, matches; telemetry schema has inference_calls(cost_usd,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens,subagent_role), matches lib/telemetry.ts and protected fixture (no uploaded DB was supplied to inspect); index header exactly ID/Title/Status/Implemented by/Date first added/Former path, matches. Node v24.18.0 imports node:sqlite DatabaseSync without flags; python3 -m zipfile -h exits 0. Plan interface at /home/george-contis/src/pi-build/lib/plan.ts is byte-identical to checkout lib/plan.ts. Baseline node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts exits 1: 131 tests, 129 pass, 1 fail, 1 skip. Only failing identity: tests/markdown.test.ts:184 'session recap predicate, explain gate, known.md, tier map', assertion at line 191 explainAfterTurn(['a.ts'], false). Therefore grounding's expected no old failing tests is not reproduced; it does not alter design and must not be fixed here. Run each older docs/specs/*.tests/*.ts separately: SPEC-0005 7/7, 0006 39/39, 0009 13/13, 0010 42/42, 0011 23/23, 0014 11/11, 0015 22/22, 0018 26/26 all exit 0. uv run --project tools/map pytest -q docs/specs/SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests/test_map_views.py exits 0, 9 passed. New SPEC-0019 protected suite exits 1, 16 test entries/2 pass/14 fail (includes missing exports/modules); not a regression baseline for older code. Raw logs and per-command JSON: /tmp/spec0019-planning/{unit-baseline.log,spec-baselines.json,SPEC-*.tests.log,SPEC-0014-complete-the-codebase-map.tests.python.log}; portable planning-checks.json in this plan directory records the results. No design-changing contradiction found. Preserve all protected files, planner/gate checks, models, thinking, scripts/run-plan.mjs, quota and evidence formats. No paid model-driven run; real full landing and SPEC-0018 deferred handoff paths remain not exercised. Interpret §8's broad no-branch-movement invariant as governing pipeline implementation/landing, not forbidding §6.7's explicitly required pre-run installer commit; report this necessary O6 exception without broadening landing. Do not mark spec/index implemented during planning. No sealed memory note is edited.

Stage 6.1 — edit lib/pipeline.ts only. Read that file and docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/preflight-gate.test.ts; no caller inspection/adaptation needed. Implement new exports uncommittedSpecPaths(dirty: string[], paths: { spec: string; tests: string }): string[] and gateRepairable(errors: string[]): boolean; extend existing exported PreflightInput with specPaths?: { spec: string; tests: string }, leaving preflight(input: PreflightInput): Preflight and Preflight { checks: number|null; blocking: string[]; warnings: string[] } compatible. Parse raw porcelain lines as XY + space + path; rename old -> new uses destination; return path strings, not XY lines, in input order. Select exact spec; exact tests path with/without trailing slash; descendants using tests + '/' boundary; untracked entries (XY == '??') ending '/' that are ancestor directories of spec/tests. Do not match unrelated prefix siblings, tracked ancestor directories or rename sources. Preflight, only when specPaths supplied and matches nonempty, adds ONE blocker containing 'uncommitted', specPaths.spec, 'HEAD', and every matching path; no unrelated paths in it. Retain the existing dirty warning verbatim, all existing blockers and order, countVerifyChecks, Python/quota logic and results without specPaths. gateRepairable returns !errors.includes('verification count changed') with exact case-sensitive equality; [] and ordinary gate errors return true. No new dependencies. Keep STOP_AND_REPORT exactly 'Do not implement this spec with other tools. Report this result to the user and wait for instructions.'; do not alter any other export, helper, planner prompt, models or settings. Forbidden edits: every other file, bin/pi-implement, all tests and specs, this .plan test/plan.json, notes, router and quota wiring. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/preflight-gate.test.ts. Do not implement landing or later stages.

Stage 6.2 — edit only lib/pipeline.ts, after L01 on this same file. Read lib/pipeline.ts and docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/landing.test.ts. Add exactly landReviewBranch(input: { target: string; branch: string; base: string; baseBranch: string|null; enabled: boolean }): { landed: boolean; onto?: string; reason: string }. Synchronous node:child_process execFileSync git -C target operations; no new package or caller changes. Ordered decisions: !enabled -> {landed:false, reason containing 'disabled'}; baseBranch===null -> reason containing 'detached'; read symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD (nonzero denotes current detached HEAD), if different from baseBranch refuse and name current branch (use 'detached HEAD' when none); compare rev-parse baseBranch with base, mismatch -> reason containing 'moved'; attempt git merge --ff-only branch, catch -> reason containing 'fast-forward' plus git's FIRST error line from stderr (not stdout's Updating line); success -> git branch -d branch, ignore deletion error, return landed:true, onto:baseBranch, reason naming success. Do not switch branches, reset, force, rebase, stash, clean, stage or create a merge commit. Refusals preserve both refs, index and local edits; unrelated tracked/untracked edits must survive a successful ff. Calls are argument arrays, not shell interpolation. base is required string here: the runner, not this helper, handles legacy metadata missing base; do not infer a base from current HEAD. Any inability to read target state must safely refuse without branch mutation. Keep all old exports and L01 helpers/preflight intact, including STOP_AND_REPORT literal 'Do not implement this spec with other tools. Report this result to the user and wait for instructions.'. Forbidden edits: every other file, all protected/plan tests and specs, this plan, runner/callers, settings/models/router/quota/notes. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/landing.test.ts and L01 test. Do not wire landing into the runner.

Stage 6.3 — create only lib/run-summary.ts; this is a self-contained read-only formatter, with all producer schemas supplied here (no cross-file inference). Read docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/summary.test.ts and spec §6.3. Export buildSummary(input: { runDir: string; outcome: { ok: boolean; stage: string; reason: string; next?: string; landed?: string; branch?: string } }): string. Use built-in node:fs/path and node:sqlite DatabaseSync readOnly; no model, subprocess, network, new package or other repository imports required. File schemas: pipeline.json {spec: repo-relative string like docs/specs/SPEC-0042-demo.md, branch: review string, base?: full hash, baseBranch?: string|null, startedAt: ISO string, stamp: string}; gate-N.log plain errors with ZERO-based N, gate.json {result:'pass',checks:number}; results.jsonl rows {id, acceptance:'pass'|'fail', model:string, rounds:number, providerCost:number}; grade.json {specTests:{code:number|null},planTests:{code:number|null},typecheck:{code:number|null}}; report.md is evidence file. Telemetry DB table inference_calls has cost_usd REAL, prompt_tokens INTEGER, completion_tokens INTEGER (extra columns irrelevant). Sections in order: title containing SPEC ID from pipeline.spec; Status Failed when !ok, else Landed on <landed> when supplied, else Handed off, stage/reason, kept branch (outcome.branch or metadata.branch when not landed) and optional next; Run spec path, base.slice(0,7), baseBranch, startedAt and runDir; Plan gate sorted numerically by N, each 'Gate round N+1:' with log content, plus 'Passed' for gate.json pass, 'not reached' when neither file source; Tasks each JSONL row in row order with id/acceptance/model/rounds/providerCost, 'none recorded' when absent/empty; Final grade labels exactly 'spec tests: pass/fail/not run', 'plan tests: ...', 'typecheck: ...' (0 pass, nonzero fail, null/missing not run), 'Grade not reached' when no grade file; Sessions markdown table, recursively find filenames ending telemetry.db, exclude directory names branch and work at any depth, deterministic relative-path ordering, name filename with '-telemetry.db' suffix removed when present, COUNT(*) and sums COALESCE(...,0), every row then Total row, all costs '$' + toFixed(2); Integration report absolute resolve(runDir,'report.md') only if present. Missing files/metadata must be visibly 'missing' or the specified missing-stage phrase, never throw; close every SQLite handle in finally. No current-time/random values and no writes to files/DBs. Empty directory produces zero totals and useful failure reason. Do not inline report content or change evidence formats. No additional export needed. Forbidden edits: any other file, protected or plan tests, spec/plan.json, callers/runner, notes/settings/models/telemetry producer and scripts/run-plan.mjs. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/summary.test.ts.

Stage 6.4 — edit only lib/progress.ts. Read it and docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/progress.test.ts; caller interfaces are pinned here, no caller edits required. Extend ProgressStage and internal STAGES to include 'install' and 'land' in addition to existing 'preflight','plan','gate','tasks','integration','grade','handoff'. Extend ProgressEvent's done member {type:'done';ok:boolean;branch?:string;runRecord?:string;summary?:string} with landed?:string, summaryPath?:string. Existing exported interfaces ProgressState/ProgressTask and role union remain compatible; exported functions keep signatures parseProgressLine(line:string):ProgressEvent|null, initialProgress(spec:string):ProgressState, reduceProgress(state:ProgressState,event:ProgressEvent):ProgressState, progressSummary(state:ProgressState):string, renderProgress(state:ProgressState,expanded:boolean):string[]. Done validator must apply existing optionalString to both fields: absent or string allowed, null/number/bool/object/array rejected. Keep existing done validation and all non-done validation unchanged. Both progressSummary and renderProgress use 'Landed on ' + landed instead of 'Handed off' when a successful done carries landed, omit any 'Branch:' line whenever landed is present, append 'Summary: ' + summaryPath when supplied. A kept branch still says Handed off; errors still say Failed. Compact renderProgress must also expose landing status and summary link when new fields present, while retaining its headline and latest summary text. Choose a small local helper if useful, not a new exported API. Without new fields produce byte-identical current output, including compact output, expanded omission of done.summary, costs/order and activity; preserve childEventToProgress, finalText, reduceProgress semantics. No additional package, settings or caller changes. Forbidden edits: every other file, tests (including this acceptance), spec/plan.json, extensions/pipeline.ts, bin/pi-implement, scripts/run-plan.mjs, models/quota/router/notes. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test docs/specs/SPEC-0019-land-runs-and-summarize-every-exit.plan/progress.test.ts.

Stage 6.5 — edit bin/pi-implement only; Sol owns lifecycle/CLI/git/progress integration across the newly declared helpers. Read spec §6.5, this runner, lib/pipeline.ts, lib/progress.ts, lib/run-summary.ts and protected runner.test.ts. Import uncommittedSpecPaths/gateRepairable/landReviewBranch/buildSummary; retain unchanged planPrompt and gate checks. Capture actual raw porcelain without the git helper's .trim() dropping first-line leading status whitespace, then pass specPaths:{spec:specRel,tests:testRel} to REAL preflight only. Dry run omits it and emits explicit matching-path warning to stderr+notice. Block before any artifacts/calls. Capture startCommit and startBranch before fresh branch creation, persist base/baseBranch metadata, create branch from exact hash. Avoid name collision with current 'base' variable, which is the run-directory root. Initialize tracked stage/runDir/kept worktree safely before finish/exit/error handlers can execute (avoid TDZ on early failures); set runDir immediately after directory creation and on resume. stage() updates tracking even in terminal mode; forwarding tasks/integration stage events must also update it. Refactor finish to write summary.md through buildSummary for every post-directory completion, add absolute summaryPath to exactly one done event, and use current stage/reason/kept branch/landed/next. Catch summary build/write errors, print stderr and preserve original exit code/outcome; mark done at a safe point to avoid recursive exception handling. For exit 75/130, next names implement_spec({spec:<query>,resume:true}) and bin/pi-implement <query> --repo <target> --resume (include bin/pi-continue hint for quota); other exits instruct fix reason then new run, naming retained worktree path(s). Preserve early no-run behaviour and exit codes 0/1/2/75/130. After each gate-N.log write, nonrepairable error exits 1 before repair pi, saying run spec differs from one preflight read, commit and start a new run; keep ordinary repairs unchanged. Both plan-only terminal/progress success invoke finish(true,text,{branch}), then exit 0 retaining worktree. After final passing grade, handoff commit and both removals, emit stage land; with metadata base/baseBranch call landReviewBranch({target,branch,base,baseBranch,enabled:settings.pipeline?.land!==false}). A recorded baseBranch:null is a valid detached start, passed to helper; absent legacy base/baseBranch must skip helper, retain branch and explain no recorded base. Never recompute legacy base and never land failures. Finish success with {landed:result.onto,runRecord} on landing (no branch), else {branch,runRecord}, with refusal reason in summary text. Terminal mode prints one success/refusal line. Update header to describe install/commit, summaries and safe landing (source wiring follows S08). Do not change run record format/report content or arbitrary-target ownership, hold/resume/abort and worktree-cleanup policy. Review count-mismatch/no-repair, hold/interruption and old-resume branches even where protected tests cannot execute without planning; explicitly report review vs tests. No edits to tests, scripts/run-plan.mjs, prompts/models/thinking/quota or other files.

Stage 6.6 — edit extensions/pipeline.ts only. Sol owns cross-file completion/CLI/progress agreement. Read lib/progress.ts, STOP_AND_REPORT/implementArgs in lib/pipeline.ts, runner finish contract, protected progress-tool.test.ts and existing pipeline-tool fixtures. Keep default factory API/options, harness/target checks, direct exposure, spawn env and signal streaming unchanged. HandedOff = !aborted && code===0 && done.ok===true && runRecord && (branch||landed). Separate successful plan-only predicate requires params.planOnly, !aborted, code 0, done.ok, branch, no runRecord; this must not mask a malformed/no-handoff call without planOnly. Both succeed with isError:false and no stop sentence. Plan-only appends exactly 'Plan gate passed on `<branch>`. To implement it, call implement_spec again with resume: true.' to progressSummary. All remaining outcomes preserve existing quota/preflight/abort/spawn diagnostics and isError:true ending with STOP_AND_REPORT exactly 'Do not implement this spec with other tools. Report this result to the user and wait for instructions.'. Ensure failure summary path flows through progressSummary, not special-case text duplication. Retain Sol plans/Luna implements/Sol integrates and If it fails sentences, replace only obsolete never-writes-main promise with safe fast-forward of unchanged starting branch / otherwise review branch. spec parameter description includes downloaded .md or .zip installed then run; pass original spec unchanged, including ~/Downloads paths. Preserve parameters, repo argument construction, renderResult and onUpdate semantics. Read relevant installed pi extension API documentation before editing; no new extension, no prompt/guideline/namespace stop instruction and no protected test changes. Run protected progress-tool.test.ts and tests/pipeline-tool.test.ts (unmodified).

Stage 6.7 — create only lib/install-spec.ts. Sol, not Luna, owns source-tree/index/commit transaction decisions and cross-file identity grammar. Read §6.7, protected install.test.ts, lib/specs.ts listSpecs grammar and real docs/specs/index.md header (not notes). Export InstallResult = {ok:true;id:string;slug:string;spec:string;tests:string|null;title:string;indexRow:string;committed:boolean;commit?:string}|{ok:false;error:string}; installSpec(input:{target:string;source:string;today:string;dryRun?:boolean}):InstallResult, synchronous. Match SPEC-([0-9A-Za-z]+)-([a-z0-9-]+).md and exclude slug run, consistent with resolver; zip root/docs/specs sources only selected spec plus sibling .tests, extras ignored. Exactly one candidate must remain, even when same ID appears twice. Reject unsupported source/count/ID clash BEFORE target writes, return error (not throw as normal refusal). Use Python standard zipfile to extract in scratch with no new dependency, always remove scratch in finally; never extract directly into target. Validate archive paths remain in scratch, do not follow archive entries into target. .md brings sibling stem.tests if directory exists. Determine all planned target changes first; NNNN = max all-digit IDs in existing spec filenames AND index rows + 1, padStart(4,'0'), 0001 when none; retain explicit IDs. Replace SPEC-NNNN globally in text contents of installed spec/tests; install renamed stem. Explicit ID different existing slug refuses without target/index/HEAD mutation; matching ID+slug fully replaces tests (deletions included) and spec, not a merge with old test files. H1 after placeholder replacement is title; derive header Status else ready. Existing index header dictates row cells: ID, Title, Status, any starting Date gets today, all other columns em dash. Add row iff no ID row; preserve existing row even revised H1/status. No index -> create heading '# Specifications', five specified columns and separator. spec/tests result paths repo-relative, absent tests null; indexRow returns selected existing/computed row. dryRun computes same result committed:false without target writes, directories, git index mutation or commit. For real changes stage only installed spec/tests/index, include deletions for previous tests, then git commit -m 'Add SPEC-<id>: <H1 with leading SPEC-<id>: removed>' -- <those paths>. Never commit unrelated staged work or clear unrelated index entries; path-scope diff/no-op detection, omit pathspecs for absent never-tracked tests so git doesn't fail. If identical installation, do not commit, committed:false; on commit true include rev-parse HEAD hash. Commit/hook or filesystem errors must be reported without pretending install succeeded; a returned refusal must restore scoped target files/index state if mutation started, preserving unrelated work without resetting branches. Validate ordinary input refusals before any mutation. Respect §5: no changes to lib/specs.ts, run record, integration report, tests, settings, prompts or any other module.
